business.prompt: The United States securities regulator publishes a structured frame for each accounting concept and calendar year, listing every filer that reported that concept together with the business address it has on record. Take the frame for research and development expense covering calendar year 2018, and keep only those filers whose recorded business address places them in Texas. Within that restricted group one filer reported a larger figure for the concept than every other. Report the Central Index Key that the regulator assigns to that single filer. Confirm the key against an independent structured knowledge base before answering. Give the digits of the key alone, without leading zeros or any label.

celebrities/public figures.prompt: The Nobel Prize registry publishes a record for every laureate, giving the person's name, date of birth and the place where they were born. Restrict attention to the laureates recognised in Chemistry for awards made between 1901 and 1975 whose record carries a complete date of birth. Among that group one laureate was born earlier than every other. Report the city recorded as that single laureate's place of birth. Confirm the birthplace against an independent structured knowledge base before answering. Give the city name alone, spelled as the registry records it.

education.prompt: A public register of higher education institutions lists the universities and colleges of Portugal, recording the internet domain each one uses. Consider only the institutions that this register places in Portugal and for which it records at least one domain. Order the primary domains of those institutions as text, from first to last. One domain falls later in that ordering than every other. Report that single last-ordered domain. Confirm the institution through an independent structured knowledge base. Give the domain alone, in lower case, with no protocol and no path.

health and medicine.prompt: The United States public clinical trials registry records interventional studies of multiple sclerosis, each with a phase, a recruitment status and a start date. Consider only those studies recorded as phase 3 and as having reached completion. Within that set exactly one began earlier than every other. Report the registry identifier assigned to that single earliest study. Verify the identifier appears on an independent structured knowledge base. Answer with the identifier alone, in its standard eight-digit registry form.

history.prompt: The Nobel Prize registry records every Chemistry award with its year and the full list of laureates who shared it. Consider only the Chemistry awards made between 1901 and 2000 that were divided among 3 or more laureates, and take the first laureate listed on each of those awards. Order those first-listed laureates alphabetically by full name; one of them stands before all the others. Report the year of the award on which that single laureate is listed first. Confirm the laureate against an independent structured knowledge base before answering. Give the four digits of the year alone, with no other words.

sports.prompt: The official Major League Baseball statistics service publishes the full season roster of the Chicago Cubs for 2016, listing every player the club carried that year with his date and place of birth. Consider only the players appearing on that full season roster. Exactly one of them was born earlier than every other player on the list. Report the city of birth that the service records for that single oldest player. Confirm the birthplace against two references independent of the league. Give the city name alone, as recorded, with no state, no country and no other words.

travel.prompt: The OpenFlights project distributes an airline route table and a separate airport table, each as a plain delimited file covering worldwide civil aviation. Consider only the nonstop destinations served by the carrier with IATA code LH departing from its hub at FRA, as recorded in that route table. Join those destinations to the airport table and find the one lying furthest north. Report the three-letter IATA code of that single northernmost destination. Cross-check the coordinates against a second independent aerodrome register. Answer with the three-letter code only, capitalised, and nothing else.

tv shows and movies.prompt: The IMDb public title export records, for every film it lists, the title, the year of release, the genres assigned to it and the running time in minutes. Restrict attention to titles typed as feature films with a release year of 1999 that carry the Fantasy genre and a recorded running time. Among only those, one film runs longer than every other. Report the IMDb title identifier of that single longest film. Confirm the identifier against an independent structured knowledge base before answering. Give the identifier alone, beginning with the two letters that prefix it, and nothing else.

video games.prompt: The Valve storefront exposes a public record for each catalogue title, giving the name the store prints for it and the studio credited with developing it. Consider the titles carried under the store application numbers 4000, 6910, 22380, 39210, 105600, 108600, 220200, 236850, 255710, 268910, 322330, 367520, 413150 and 427520, taking each name exactly as printed. Reduce each printed name to its letters and digits in lower case, then order those reduced names; one stands before all the others. Report the developing studio that the store credits for that single first-ordered title. Confirm the studio against an independent structured knowledge base before answering. Give the studio name alone, exactly as the store prints it.
